scope: Repository stabilization audit with source review, regression fixes, offline verification, production-browser smoke tests, and read-only hosted preview checks.

environment.browser: Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (existing Playwright revision 1243, explicit executable override)

findings.problem: Repository verification failed because the research manifest no longer matched current package and implementation hashes.
findings.fix: Regenerated only the research manifest; retained the existing datasets, models, evaluations, contracts, and measurements.
findings.verification: Repository integrity passes all seven groups; frozen research artifacts remain valid.

findings.problem: The root engines range and repository verifier accepted untested future Node majors, including Node 26, which previously failed installing Recrypt.
findings.fix: Bound root engines to Node 20.19+, 22.12+, and 24.x; aligned the lockfile and verifier; added boundary regression coverage.
findings.verification: Supported LTS lines accepted; Node 25/26 and older 20/22 minors rejected.

findings.problem: Malformed or non-string SIWE messages could throw parser/type errors that became HTTP 500.
findings.fix: Validate input types and translate SIWE parsing failures into a sanitized HTTP 400.
findings.verification: Malformed payload regressions pass without database access or parser-detail disclosure.

findings.problem: Unsupported evidence MIME types and Multer size/count errors lacked HTTP client-error status codes and reached the global handler as server errors.
findings.fix: Return HTTP 415 for unsupported MIME, 413 for oversized files, and 400 for multipart count/format errors; keep one-file and 10 MiB limits.
findings.verification: Local HTTP multipart tests pass for valid encrypted data, unsupported MIME, duplicate files, and oversized data.

findings.problem: The wallet-login diagnostic omitted the required SIWE message, printed the entire login response including the token, and did not signal CLI failure reliably.
findings.fix: Send the full SIWE payload, verify the protected profile and wallet, revoke the diagnostic session in finally, print only public identity/status, and return a failing exit code on CLI error.
findings.verification: Mocked protocol tests verify payload, protected request, logout, missing challenge rejection, and absence of the token from logs.

findings.problem: An Oracle could become initialized despite a failed first poll, erase that failure, and remain ready after later poll failures or stale progress; missing role only emitted a warning.
findings.fix: Require successful recent polling and no current error for readiness; retain poll failures; reject initialization without ORACLE_ROLE while keeping retry behavior.
findings.verification: Readiness tests cover startup, disabled workers, stale progress, polling errors, and recovery. A real disabled child process returns liveness 200 and readiness 503.

findings.problem: Hosted preflight accepted any nonempty Oracle instance ID, allowing both URLs to point to the same worker; enabled but unready workers could pass. IPv6 loopback detection used the wrong hostname form.
findings.fix: Require expected worker IDs 1 and 2, a boolean enabled flag, and readiness when enabled; reject credential-bearing URLs and bracketed IPv6 loopback.
findings.verification: Focused response/URL regressions and the real hosted preview preflight pass.

findings.problem: Authentication middleware mapped database/RPC outages and role revocations to HTTP 401, causing the frontend interceptor to clear valid sessions during infrastructure failures.
findings.fix: Keep JWT/session failures at 401, return 403 for role revocation, and return sanitized 503 for authentication dependency failures.
findings.verification: Regressions verify valid access, expired/revoked sessions, role revocation, RPC outage, MongoDB outage, and recovery using the same token.

checks.notes: Read-only checks of the existing deployment. Local audit fixes have not been deployed.

initialFailures.detail: One repository-integrity task failed on the stale research manifest; all seven groups pass after regeneration.
Five tests could not launch missing Chromium revision 1234. Matching-browser download stalled and audit-owned installers were stopped. All five pass using installed Chromium revision 1243.
CRLF in edited files was flagged as trailing whitespace; normalized only the three edited JavaScript files to LF.

reviewNotes.architecture: Existing architecture, contract state machines, payment rules, and role boundaries retained.
reviewNotes.refactoring: Extracted a small testable Oracle readiness predicate; made hosted preflight and wallet diagnostic import-safe and testable. Avoided broad rewrites or speculative deletion of compatibility/research code.
reviewNotes.evidencePreservation: Retained new production HTML/screenshots and restored the four earlier tracked screenshots removed by report generation.
reviewNotes.secrets: No environment files modified and no credential material included in this summary.
